prova:
have h1 : (fun n : ℕ ↦ (hypergraphRamsey 2 (n + 1) : ℝ) - (hypergraphRamsey 2 n : ℝ)) ≫
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
  rw [ asymptotic_GrowthAtTop.eq ]
  ext n
  simp
  ring
exact h1
-- PROOF
have h1 : (fun n : ℤ ↦ (1 : ℤ)) ≫ (fun n : ℤ ↦ (2 : ℤ)) := by
  rw [ Asymptotic.growthAtTop_eq ]
  ext n
  simp
  ring
exact h1
